purpose: Teach: 大尉/同書/号証/線形/密集/細心/デモンストレーション/もとづく
target_vocab: デモンストレーション

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お取引先の社長は元軍人で大尉でいらしたわ
lines.en: Our business partner's president was a former military officer—a captain, actually.
lines.style: Measured, informative tone. Slight pause before 'a captain' as if recalling a detail. Professional register, but with a touch of personal observation. Steady pacing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。報告書で同書の引用を整理します
lines.en: Yes. I'll organize the references from that report.
lines.style: Attentive, ready-to-move-forward. Brief and competent. No hesitation—this is familiar work. Light, businesslike cadence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 訴訟関連の乙第二号証を確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's verify the litigation evidence—Exhibit B.
lines.style: Directive but not harsh. Crisp opening on the verb. Expectation of focus from the listener. Clear, purposeful pace. No room for drift.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。売上の線形回帰分析を出します
lines.en: Yes. I'll pull the linear regression analysis on sales figures.
lines.style: Assured, task-oriented. Short and direct. The tone of someone who knows exactly what's needed and will deliver it. Even pacing, no elaboration.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 混雑し密集した売り場の改善案を出しましょう
lines.en: Let's come up with a proposal to improve the crowded retail floor.
lines.style: Directive, collaborative. 'Let's' carries shared responsibility. Thoughtful but not slow. Strategic angle—this is a problem to solve together.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商談には細心の準備を致します
lines.en: Yes. We'll prepare thoroughly for the business discussions.
lines.style: Earnest assurance. Slight emphasis on 'thoroughly'—this matters. Quiet determination. Professional courtesy in the delivery, not robotic.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新製品のデモンストレーションを計画しましょう
lines.en: Let's plan the demonstration for the new product line.
lines.style: Forward-moving, purposeful. Crisp opening. This is a next step. Confident pacing. Strategic tone—preparing for impact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。判断は調査結果にもとづく方針です
lines.en: Yes. We'll base our decisions on what the survey findings show.
lines.style: Measured conclusion. Even pace. Professional closure—grounding decisions in evidence. Calm, reliable. This is how we proceed.
